name: design-decisions
body: Design decisions: (1) Goldmark-style CommonMark AST walk to whitelist nodes, extensions disabled. (2) Go html/template for layouts (auto-escaping). (3) Live reload via a lightweight server push (SSE/websocket) endpoint; rebuild atomically swaps the rendered deck or error state (never partial). (4) Default port chosen by implementation; if busy, error with `--port` hint. (5) No build/export: PDF via reveal.js ?print-pdf.
